tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /red mda' bas mdzad pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i rim pa don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal ldan bla ma dang / /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' la btud nas/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i/ /cho ga'i rim pa rab gsal bri bar bya/ /'dir rdo rje theg pa'i lam la mos shing / dngos grub rnam pa gnyis don du gnyer bas/ dang por mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma la/ dbang bskur ba nod par byas te/ dbang bskur ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du yang / phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud las/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir kyang mar med ltar/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med la 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma la ni dbang nod zhu/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dbang bskur ba yang / dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro ba can yin la/ dkyil 'khor de yang / gang zag gi dbang po'i rim pas rnam pa gsum ste/ 'di ltar dbang po rab la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang / 'bring la thig la tshon bkye ba rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang / dbang po tha ma lha sku phyag rgya chen po zhal phyag gi rnam pa can med par yid mi ches pa rnams la/ ri mor gnas pa'i las/ ras ris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang bskur ba dang gsum yin te/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas/ dbang bskur dkyil 'khor sngon 'gro bar/ /rdo rje 'chang gis bshad pa ste/ /'on kyang dkyil 'khor de'i rang bzhin/ /ci yin de ni 'di ltar bshad/ /ri mor gnas pa'i las dang ni/ /thig la tshon bkye'i rim pa bstan/ /'gro ba de nyid rang bzhin gyis/ /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de la 'dir/ ras ris kyi dkyil 'khor de la brten nas/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i rim pa bshad par bya'o/ /de yang cho ga sbyor ba dang / dngos dang / rjes gsum gyi/ dang po la yang / gsol dang bsnyen pa'i las dang ni/ /sa gzhi yongs su gzung ba dang / /lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga ste/ /sbyor ba'i yan lag rnam pa bzhi/ /de la thog mar/ slob ma dad pa dang ldan pas/ bla ma la yan lag lngas phyag 'tshal te/ maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro ba'i me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar la/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /zhes sogs kyi lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa dang / bla mas/ khyod kyi bsam pa dag pas/ yo byad phun sum tshogs par gyis shig dang / kho bos kyang ji ltar nus pas rjes su gzung bar bya'o/ /zhes kyang brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba la 'jug par dbang zhing / bar du gcod pa rnams las rgyal ba dang / slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis brlab pa la nus pa dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ bsnyen pa'i las brtsam par bya'o/ /de'ang bum pa la brten pa'i cho ga ni/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bum pa sta gon du gnas pa dang 'dra zhing / ma brten pa'i phyogs ni/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba dang mthun la/ ji srid du mtshan ma mthong gi bar du zla ba'am/ yang na gtso bo la 'bum phrag gcig dang 'khor rnams la khri phrag re re bzla'o/ /bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas/ 'tshe ba med cing yo byad phun gsum tshogs la/ rnal 'byor dang mthun pa'i sa yi cha/ sngar yongs su ma sbyang par sa'i cho ga byas te/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang gtor ma gcig bshams la/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir ba byung dang / dri bzang gi byugs pa'i dbus su/ oṃ pṛ thi wi dā+e wi zhes pas me tog gi tshom bu bkod la/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ bam̐ las sa'i lha mo ser mo/ phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin cing /

bdag la phyogs par bskyed pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐ bkod nas/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag la ham̐ dmigs te/ sa la btugs pa las 'od 'phros pas/ sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa gdan drangs la/ tshom bu la bstims te/ dbang bskur nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan pa la/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyi'i mchod rdzas rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing oṃ pṛ thi wi dā+e wi grih+ne daṃ/ zhes sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ pra ti ts+tsha ye swāhā la sogs pa so so'i sngags kyis phul nas/ nang bdud rtsis kyang mchod la oṃ ā hūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab pa'i gtor ma/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tha khaṃ ud ga te s+pha ra na i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ di swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyi phul la/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas nas dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du/ sa phyogs 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal bas/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing / las kyi dngos grub dag kyang bdag la bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs kyi bu khyod ci dga' bar spyod cig ces pas gnang ba byin zhing dpang por mdzad par bsams nas/ oṃ badz+ra muṃḥzhes pas de nyid du thim par bsam mo/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su langs la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas mig g.yas g.yon gnyis su/ ma dang / ṭa las nyi zla hūm̐ gi mtshan par dmigs la/ g.yas nas g.yon du blta bas bgegs rnams tshar bcad pa dang / g.yon nas g.yas su blta bas rjes su bzung bar bsams la/

rdo rje slob dpon dag gis/ sa'i phyogs 'dir sems can gyi don rtsom gyi/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang / ma mo dang / srin po la sogs pa gang dag 'di na gnas pa'i sa'i bdag po myur du song zhig 'di ltar mi bskyod pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa he ru ka'i bka' mnos nas myur du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de la/ nga yis ye shes kyi rdo rje 'dis spyi bo rnam pa brgyar gas par bya'o zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor lta bar mi dbang ba'i nag po'i phyogs rnams bskrad cing / dkar po'i phyogs snod du gyur pa rnams/ /zhi ba'i yid kyis bdag gi grogs byed par bsam mo/ /sa blang ba'o/ /de nas lto 'phye'i lto ba'i phyogs nas/ pus mo nub tsam du bskos te/ gyo mo dang / sol ba dang / rus bu la sogs pa'i zug rngu rnams phyung nas dri bzang dang / rin po che la sogs pa'i sa brnyan bzang pos bkang ste/ 'thas par brdungs la/ shar dang byang du gzhol zhing / me long gi ngos ltar 'jam pa'i sa yi stegs bu gru bzhi pa byas pa'i steng dang 'khor yug kun du lag pa gnyis bzhag cing oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes brjod pas/ phyogs thams cad nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo/ /sa sbyang ba'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su kha shar du bltas te/ bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas 'dug la/ seng ldeng gi phur bu sor brgyad pa'i tshad can la tsan+dan dmar po byug cing / srad bu dmar po dang / me tog gi phreng bas brgyan te/ stod khro bo/ smad phur bu'i rnam pa can gyis khro bo bcur bskyed la/ ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas nas/ dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab ste/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od kyi/ bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams bkug nas/ spyi bor phur bus gdab pa'i phyir/

rang gi snying kha nas spros pa'i khro bo rnams kyis/ g.yon pas phur bu rnams bzung / g.yas pas rdo rje tho ba bzung nas/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ rdo rje tho bas brdungs par bsam zhing / khro bo so so'i sngags dang sbyar ba'i oṃ gha gha zhes sogs dang / badz+ra mud ga ra zhes sogs brjod pas/ bgegs rnams kyi lus bsregs nas sdig pa sbyang bar bsam zhing / dngos su dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor yug gi phyogs bcur phur bu rnams gdab/ de'ang steng gi shar dang / 'og gi nub tu gdab bo/ /de nas sa'i phyogs der sgrub thabs bzhin/ srung ba'i 'khor lo rgyas par bsgoms nas suṃ bha'i sngags yang yang bzlas te bstan par bya ba ni/ sa bsrung ba'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i 'gros kyi byang shar du song la/ sngar bzhin du bgegs la bka' sgos nas/ g.yon skor gyis bskor zhing / shar du g.yas brkyang / lhor g.yon brkyang / nub tu sa ga byang du zlum po la sogs pa'i rkang stabs kyi bkod pa rnams kyi sa gzung ba'am/ yang na de ltar ma byas kyang 'gal ba med pas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor bzhengs la/ sems can gyi don bya'o snyam du yid kyis bzung ba ni/ sa gzung ba ste sa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa'o/ /lha khang dang / phyugs lhas dang / brag steng dang / yang thog la sogs pa rnams su ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i sa'i cho ga 'di dag mi dgos so/ /de nas sta gon la 'jug par bya ste/ de'ang / sa yi lha mo lhag gnas dang / /lha dang de bzhin bum pa dang / /slob ma lhag par gnas pa ste/ /sta gon cho ga rnam pa bzhi/ /de la thog mar/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa rgyan gyis nye bar brgyan la/ stegs bu'i dbus su/ pad rag gi tshad kyi maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa ba byung lnga dri bzang dang bcas pa byugs pa'i 'khor yug tu/ mchod pa rnams kyis bskor zhing gtor ma rnams dang / 'og tu nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang sta gon bya'o/

/de nas phyi ma red kyi tshe/ rdo rje slob dpon bsgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pa/ so so'i stan la 'khod de/ der 'dus pa'i bgegs dang 'byung po rnams la/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis bsngos nas/ snod ma yin rnams bskrad cing / snod ldan rnams la grogs bcol la gnas dang yo byad rnams thogs pa med la/ dwangs shing rgya che bar byin gyis brlabs te/ rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya'o/ /de nas las kyi slob mas rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba btab nas/ yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs te/ bdag bskyed bsgoms la/ mchod pa dang bzlas pa'i bar rdzogs par bya'o/ /de nas rang gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdus te/ gtso bo 'ba' zhig gi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ mchod rdzas rnams bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags kyi bsang zhing / swā bhā was sbyangs nas yi ge gsum las lha rdzas kyi mchod pa phun sum tshogs par bskyed la/ so so'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas sa blang ba'i skabs ltar/ sa'i lha mo lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /de nas lha sta gon du gnas pa'i phyir/ me tog dman pa rnams bsdus la/ ba byung lngas g.yas skor du khye ma med par byug cing / lag pa rdo rje bsdams pa nang du byas la/ sa de mnan te/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsgom nas/ oṃ badz+ra dhi ḍā tiṣ+ṭha zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /der sa bon las bskyed pa'am skad cig gis srung ba'i 'khor lo sngon du 'gro ba'i gzhal yas khang rdzogs par bskyed la/ lha'i gnas rnams su rang rang gi sngags lan gsum gsum brjod de dri'i thig le/ gtso bo dang / de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi la gru bzhi/ gzhan rnams la zlum po re byas pa'i steng du/ me tog gi tshom bu re bkod nas/ rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum gyi mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs nas sku'i dbyibs brgyud de/ yum gyi khar babs pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis su gyur pa rnams badz+ra dhṛka la sogs pa'i 'byin sngags kyis phyung nas/ tshom bu so so la bkod pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par gsal btab nas rang lha snam du gnas nas lha spro ba'i lugs la lha thams cad spros zin nas gtso bo yab yum gyi lus dkyil 'god gzhan rnams kyi sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs la thams cad kyang sems dpa' sum brtseg tu gsal bar dmigs nas ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas la dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs ltar spyan drangs pa'i tshig bcad dang mchod pa sogs ji lta ba bzhin bya'o/ /dbang bskur nas/ so so'i rigs kyi bdag pos rgyal gdab bo/ /de nas/ phyi nang gsang ba yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod cing / bstod pa rnams kyis bstod la/ snyan gsan dbab pa'i phyir/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga la sa btsugs nas/ bdug spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ /dkyil 'khor bdag ni 'bri bar 'tshal/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /des na gnang ba mdzad pas rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro don mdzad brtson dang / /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gang gzhan gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skye ba'i lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /gang du rdo rje'i spyan mnga' ba'i/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /yo byad ji ltar 'byor ba yis/ /'gro ba dag phyir bdag 'bri na/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs brtse bar ni dgongs nas su/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/

/byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi mgrin gcig tu/ rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod kyis/ dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /de nas lha dang 'byung po gtor mas mnyes par byas la/ bum pa sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga bya ste/ rin po che la sogs pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i bum pa/ lto ba'i rgyar mtho lnga la/ mgrin pa'i dpangs su sor brgyad pa/ kha khyer dang mchu sor gnyis 'phyang ba/ rtsa ba zlum zhing kha dog nag po dang bral ba'i bum pa lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'am ma 'byor na las thams cad pa'i bum pa dang gnyis la/ 'gul chings rtsang ma prog lnga'am/ bdun dang ldan pas dkri zhing / me tog dang 'bras bus spud pa'i rtse mo ma nyams pa'i shing gi yal gas kha brgyan la/ gser/ dngul/ ma tig byi ru/ mu men te rin po che lnga/ nas/ 'bras/ gro/ sran ma/ til ste 'bru lnga/ sing ha/ sle tres/ bh+ya gṛ/ chu srin sder mo/ ha ya/ shu dag ha ba dhe wa/ dbang po lag pa/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri ste sman lnga/ ga bur/ gur gum/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ dza ti ste dri lnga/ 'o ma/ zho/ mar/ lan tshwa/ bu ram ste snying po lnga/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ste gsang ba'i rdzas rnams dang bcas pa/ lu ma dang 'bab chu dang / khron pa las byung ba'i chus gang bar byas la/ lha so so'i mtshan ma rnams gdags shing / rnam rgyal gyis bum pa la dung chos dri chus yongs su gang ba'i steng du/ rdo rje la gzungs thag btags pa bzhag go /de nas bum pa rnams bsang zhing sbyangs nas/ paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng du/ bh+rūm̐ la rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i bum pa rnams su bskyed nas/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa la ni/ re re'i nang du lha re re bskyed la rnam rgyal gyi bum pa 'ba' zhig las med na/ de'i nang du dkyil 'khor gyi lha rdzogs par bskyed do/

/de'ang gzhal yas khang gi dod du bum pa nyid yin/ lha rnams ni lhag par mos pa tsam mam/ yang na dkyil chog nyi shu pa las so so'i sa bon las bskyed do/ /las thams cad pa'i bum par ni bgegs mthar byed bskyed de/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ ye shes pa bcug la dbang bskur nas/ rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab pa la/ phyi nang gsang ba yid las byung bas mchod de/ gtor mas kyang mnyes par byas nas/ dung chos kyi nang du lha rnams kyis gzugs brnyan gsal bar dmigs nas/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags 'phros pas/ gzungs thag la brten nas song bas/ lha rnams kyi thugs khar phog te rgyud bskul nas/ sku thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun zags pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing / dkyil 'khor gyi lha so so'i sngags sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin bzla/ las thams cad pa la/ oṃ a bighan+na ta krid hūm̐ phaṭ ces pa bzla'o/ /slar yang mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ dung chos kyi chu bum pa rnams kyi nang du blugs pas/ lha thams cad 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi chur bsams nas/ gtso bo'i bum pa rnams kyi chu cung zad re rnam rgyal bum par bsdu'o/ / 'dir gtor ma rnams 'bul/ de nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams tshogs kyi 'khor los mnyes par byas nas bsngo ba'i bar nyams su blangs nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ dkyil 'khor la mchod cing bstod de/ bzod par gsol nas phyag rgya dang sngags kyi mkhar bzhugs su gsol te tshom bu bsdus te/ slar yang mchod bstod gsol ba gdab pa byas nas/ bdag bsrung ba byas nas/ 'od gsal gyi ngang la nyal bar byas la/ lhag ma la dga' ba'i 'byung po rnams/ lhag ma'i gtor mas tshim par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga ni/ nges 'byung bsam pa bskyed pa dang / /gsol dang nang gi dbang bskur dang / /spro ba bskyed dang sdom pa sbyin/ /bsrung dang mchod dang so shing dor/

/skyor chu blud dang bsrung skud bcing / /sdig pa sbyangs dang ku sha sbyin/ /chos bshad rmi lam yongs brtag pa/ /bcu bzhi slob ma sta gon no/ /de la thog mar/ gong du rjes su bzung ba'i slob ma rnams khrus byas zhing / gos gtsang ma bgos la/ phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas/ gral la 'khod pa rnams la/ myang 'das kyi bsam pa brtan po bskyed pa'i phyir/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang / /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug bya ste/ /bsod nams 'dod pa 'di las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /dad pa chen po ldan byas te/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer na/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste/ /'di yi 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ /gal te 'di la dmigs gyur na/ /'jig rten pha rol 'byung ma yin/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i/ /mi la 'di 'bras ma lus 'grub/ /zhes lan gcig brjod nas/ tshe 'di'i nad gdon zhi ba dang / phyi ma lha mi'i bde ba don du gnyer na/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug mi dgos shing / dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug pas ni/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob pa don du gnyer dgos pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya/ de'i phyir du/ dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug snyam pa gyis zhes brjod/ de ltar myang 'das kyi bsam pa brtan pos kun nas bslang nas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed de/ de las dbang blang ba'i phyir/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar la/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/

/mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su gzhug go /de ltar gsol ba 'debs pa'i slob ma la/ dbang bskur ba'i snod du rung bar bya ba'i phyir/ rang zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum du gsal bar dmigs la/ snyoms par zhugs pa las phyung ba'i sgras/ slob ma rnams bkug nas/ zhal tu zhugs te/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi bha gar babs pa rnams/ mi bskyod rdo rje yab yum du bskyed ces 'byung ngo / he ru ka phyag gnyis par bskyed la/ slar yang rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ rigs lnga yab yum bkug te rang gi zhal du zhugs shing / thugs khar byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rdo rje'i lam nas brgyud de/ he ru ka rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas/ ro gcig tu gyur te de nyid kyis dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab nas/ hūm̐ gi sbyor mtshams nas spros la/ shar sgor rim pa bzhin bgod do/ /de ltar snod du rung bar byas pa'i slob ma sngags kyi lam la spro bar bya ba'i phyir/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /dus gsum du ni legs byung ba'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mnyam med pa/ /rdo rje sngags kyi stobs kyis thob/ /sngags kyi sbyor ba mnyam med de/ /drag po chen po bdud kyi sde/ /stobs chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /shākya seng ge mchog la sogs/ /'jig rten mthun par gshegs nas kyang / /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces lan gcig brjod nas/ de'i don bu tshur zhes pa bod pa yin la/ khyod ni shes rab dang snying rje dang ldan pas/ tshul chen po rdo rje theg pa'i snod yin te/ de'i phyir/ khyed la gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga rnams bshad par bya'i/

khyed kyis kyang lam 'di la blo gros mi 'gyur bar gyis shig dus gsum gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyang rdo rje theg pa'i lam nas sangs rgyas pa yin no/ /zhes bshad/ de ltar yid spro bar gyur pa'i slob ma rnams/ lam gyi gzhi byang chub kyi sems dang / sdom pa sbyin pa'i phyir/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub kyi sems sbyin par bya ste/ don dran bzhin pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas/ spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa rnams byang chub kyi bar du brkyang ba'i bsam pas/ 'di skad ces brjod du gzhug go /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyis ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bdag gis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste/ bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas bdag gis gzung / /rdo rje'i rig mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang /

/yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gi bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum gyis dam tshig dang sdom pa sbyin no/ /de nas phyi nang gi bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chu sngags dang bcas pas gtor zhing bsangs nas/ lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi srin lag gis/ dri'i chu blangs pas dpral bar thig le bya zhing / oṃ zhes brjod pas 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan par bsam/ mgrin par reg cing a zhes brjod pas pad+ma dmar po as mtshan pa bsam/ snying gar reg cing hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam la/ de nas snying kha nas mas rim du hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod do/ /rdo rje dang bcas pa'i srin lag gis reg cing gsal btab/ yang yas mar reg cing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas gsal gdab bo/ /de ltar sku gsung thugs rdo rjes bsrung ba'i slob ma rnams mchod pa'i gnas su gyur pas/ me tog dang / bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de nas/ bla ma'i mdun du maṇ+ḍal zlum po khru gang gi tshad dang ldan pa la/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags bzla zhing /

ba las byung ba'i dri bzang po dang bcas pas byugs pa'i dbus su me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod la slob mas me tog phul nas/ bla ma'i mdun du kha byang shar du phyogs te 'dug pa la/ dngos grub kyis ltas brtags pa'i phyir/ 'o ma can gyi shing gi yal ga phra mo sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad dang ldan pa'i rtse mo me tog gi rgyan pa oṃ badz+ra ha sa haḥzhes brjod nas byin pa slob mas thal mo sbyar nas blangs te/ so drud la sdig pa thams cad skyugs par bsam zhing / maṇ+ḍal gyis dbus su dor ro/ /de nas/ bla mas phyogs kyi chas dngos grub kyi dbye ba bstan te/ steng du phyogs na rig 'dzin/ rang la phyogs na mchog thur du bltas na sa 'og shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhir bltas na las bzhi grub la/ mtshams su bltas na dngos grub phra mo grub bo zhes bstan to/ /de nas rmi lam gsal po mthong ba'i phyir/ baṃ las byung ba'i dung chos kyi chu la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bzlas te/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba dharma pā pāṃ niḥtsā s+ya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpā a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes bzlas te lag pa g.yas par byin nas lan gsum 'thung du gzhug go /de nas bar chad mi 'byung ba'i don du/ bu mo gtsang mas bkal ba'i skud pa dmar po/ slob ma'i lus kyi tshad dang mnyam pa sum sgril la rdo rje'i mdud pa bcing la/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i srad bur dmigs la/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs kha nas/ ye shes kyi skud pa spyan drangs nas bstim ste/ gtso bo'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs la oṃ bud+dha m+wai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarbān swāhā/ zhes zlos zhing / skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang / bud med kyi g.yas la bcings nas/ de la lag pa gnyis 'jus te/ yi ge brgya pa brjod pas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ dung chos kyi chu srin lag gis blangs la/ gnas gsum du reg cing /

oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyang bar bsams la/ sngar gyi sngags kyi mngon par bsngags pa'i skyor chu gnyis pa'ang 'thung du gzhug go /de nas rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa'i don du/ rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa'i ku sha'i chun po che chung gnyis la/ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa baṃ zhes pas/ chung ba g.yas dang che ba g.yon du sbyin no/ /de nas yid spro ba brtan cing ldog pa bya ba'i phyir/ chos zab mo bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wā ra'i me tog ltar/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gi mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa/ /bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang / /dam pa'i don gyis bden pa 'o/ /zab cing rgya che zhes bshad pa/ /rnam par rtog med zab pa ste/ /rgya che sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /'di ni bden pa gnyis su bshad/ /kun rdzob dang ni dam pa'i don/ /phyes te so sor shes nas su/ /de nas gcig tu 'das byas pa'i/ /zad med go 'phang bsgom par bya/ /skal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas nas ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gi spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu dri med na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yi gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyi/ /rnyed pa bla med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa'i/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su gzung ste skye bzhin par/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed gnas te/

/gang gi khyed rnams theg chen du/ /sang ni rab tu skye 'gyur ba/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams 'dir ni dong bas na/ /rang byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /ces brjod nas/ 'jig rten na gang dkon na/ sangs rgyas dkon te/ dper na u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ de bas kyang gsang sngags dkon te/ rtsa rgyud kyi le'u bcu bdun pa las/ thub pa chen po mar me mdzad nas/ 'od srung gi bar gyis 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang ma gsungs/ byams pa nas mos pa'i bar gyi ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang mi gsung / shākya thub pa kho nas smon lam gyi stobs kyis gsungs pa yin pas shin tu dkon no/ /dkon yang phan yon med na ci bya snyam na/ phan yon shin tu che ste/ dper na bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i mun pa mar mes skad cig la 'joms pa ltar/ tshe rabs dpag tu med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams/ sang nub dkyil 'khor chen po mthong ba tsam gyis kyang 'joms na/ gsang sngags kyi lam la zhugs te tshul bzhin bsgrubs na lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de bas na/ de lta bu'i rnyed par dka' zhing phan yon che ba'i gsang sngags khyod kyis thob kyis dga' ba sgoms shig ces pa'i don yin no zhes bshad/ de nas/ bu kye/ nang par dkyil 'khor dag mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol cig dang / rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa/ /de kun dang por nga la smros/ /ces brjod nas/ ku sha che ba stan dang / chung ba rngas su bcug la/ rtog pa gzhan gyis ma yengs par/ bdag gi nang par dkyil 'khor ji lta bu zhig mthong bar 'gyur snyam pa'i yid dang ldan pas/ gzhog g.yas pa sa 'og tu thug pa'i seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyol cig ces sgos te btang ngo / /de nas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor de la mchod cing bstod de bzod par gsol nas/

oṃ badz+rod tiṣ+ṭha zhes pa'i sngags dang / phyag rgya dang ldan pas steng gi nam mkhar bteg nas slar yang mchod cing bstod pa de nyid du bzhugs par gsol lo/ /de nas tshom bu rnams bsdus nas/ dri bzang po dang bcas pa'i ba byung gis byugs la/ gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol zhing / gtor ma nyid kyang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas dor la/ bdag nyid kyi gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod nas suṃ bha'i sngags kyi bsrungs la 'od gsal gyi ngang la nyal bar bya'o/ /nang par slob mas rmi lam bshad pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i mtshan ma mthong na spro ba bskyed do/ /mi dge ba'i mtshan ma mthong na/ bgegs dang bcas na bgegs gtor byin la/ gnod mdzes kyi sngags kyi bsrung zhing / bgegs dang bcas pa ma yin na/ zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg dang / sangs rgyas spyan gyi sngags dang / rnal 'byor la sogs pas zhi bar bya'o/ /sta gon gyis cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi ni bya ba dang / /bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang dang / /slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba/ /dngos gzhi'i bya ba rnam pa gsum/ /de la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i tshul ni/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis cho gar shes par bya'o/ /'dir ras ris la brten pa'i tshul ni/ phyi ma red kyi tshe/ tshom bu'i gzhi de nyid la/ ba byung dang dri bzang bdud rtsi dang bcas pas legs par byugs pa'i steng du gzhi bzang po bting ba la/ dkyil 'khor 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shar phyogs su zhal bstan nas bkram la 'khor yug kun tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lha grangs las mi nyung ba bshams shing / lha dang / 'byung po'i gtor ma rnams kyang bshams nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang 'tshog chas bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i phyir/ phyi ma red kyi dus su/ sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pa/ so so'i stan la 'khod nas/

sngon 'gro'i gtor ma btang ste/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ bdag skyed rdzogs par bsgom pa'i bar/ sta gon gyis skabs ltar byas nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dkyil 'khor pa thams cad la phog 'od du zhu rdo rje'i lam nas drangs ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim par bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdus la/ gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas khrus byas zhing / he ru ka'i chas rin po che'i rgyan dang gos sngon po sogs/ kyis brgyan la dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su stan nang tshang can la 'khod de las bum gyi chus gtor zhing / suṃ bha'i sngags kyis/ ras ris kyi bgegs sbyang bar bya'o/ /de nas ras ris swā bhā was sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa sgrub thabs bzhin yongs su rdzogs par bskyed do/ /lha rnams kyang lhag mos tsam gyis bskyed la/ bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum gyi mkha' gsang dang gnas lngar byin gyis brlabs nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad zhal du zhugs thugs khar rjes chags kyi mes zhu ba yum gyi bha gar babs pa'i thig le cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas par bskyed/ cha gcig cha so gnyis su gyur pa cho ga gsum gyi lha so gnyis su sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed nas/ so so'i 'byin sngags kyis rim pa bzhi phyung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu spros nas/ spyi dang khyad par gyi mdzad pa mdzad nas/ tshur 'dus pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha so so la thim par bsam/ gzhal yas khang yang phyung ste/ spros pas zhing yongs su dag par byas nas/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor la thim par bsam/ de nas gtso bo yab yum gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor sa bon gsal gdab cing / dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi yang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ thams cad kyang sems dpa' gsum brtseg tu bltas te/

rang rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' dang / de'i snying khar rang rang gi sa bon ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' bsam mo/ /de nas bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis bgegs bskrad nas/ sta gon gyi lha la mchod cing bstod de/ rdul tshon gyis dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par bya'o/ /slar yang lha rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od kyis/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drang bar bsam zhing / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon du mdzad/ /mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas shing / /rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te/ /sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig /ces lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥces brjod nas/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas se gol gtog cing / mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs pa la/ mchod cing bstod nas sgo ba bzhi'i sngags dang ting nge 'dzin dang / phyag rgyas dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / dbang du bya bas gnyis su med par byas la slar yang dbang bskur gyi lha spyan drangs pa la mchod cing bstod nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ zhes pas gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣek+ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ zhes/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab bo/ /de nas oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+ridha hūm̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya ma nu pa la ya zhes sogs lha so so'i mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i yi ge brgya pa brjod pas byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa ni/ rang gtso bo la mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du mi bskyod par bsgom he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par chad nas shar gyi lha snam gyi steng du 'dug ste/ mchod pa phul ba la sogs pa byed par bsams nas/

phyi dang nang dang yid las byung ba dang / bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams rgya cher bya zhing 'dir 'bul ba sa skya pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi lag len yin gsungs/ lha dang chos skyong mkha' 'gro ma rnams gtor mas mnyes par byas nas/ dkyil 'khor la lta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol tu gtor ma sbyin par bya ste/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs pa'i phyi bzhin 'ongs pa'i/ phyogs skyong dang 'byung po rnams skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug de las langs te gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar byed/ 'dus pa'i lha thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid du bskyed la/ dri dang me tog la sogs pas brgyan pa'i gtor ma/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ da sha di ka bya ba s+d+yi te bh+ya/ i ha ā s+d+yi te bh+yaḥtsa de ba nā ga yak+ṣa gan dharma a su ra ga ru ḍa/ kin+na ra ma ho ra ga bhu da pre ta pi shā tsi kum+bhaṇ+ḍa ud ma de a pa smā ra e tā ra ge ā di bh+yo ba dā pa yā mi gri hā tā/ pu kha sā+au ma na s+ya lā bhi no bha wan tu s+d+ya naṃ tsa nir u pa dha baṃ kurban tu sarba bhu ta i dhiṣ+ṭhā ni na oṃ āḥhūm̐ i daṃ a mṛ ta pib+naṃ bhuka tra ma ma sa pa ri wā ra s+ya shān+tiṃ kurban tu swa sti swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyi rjes la dril bu bkrol zhing / oṃ phyogs bcur rnam par gnas rnams dang / /'dir ni kun tu gnas pa dang / /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /dri za lha min nam mkha' lding / /mi 'am ci dang lto phye che/ /'byung po yi dwags sha za dang / /smyo byed dang ni brjed byed dang / /gnon po la sogs pa rnams la/ /gtor ma 'bul gyis bsnams nas kyang / /bde dang yid bde thob gyur cig /gnas 'dir nyer 'tshe med par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs kyis/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bdud rtsi yi/ /bza' ba la ni longs spyad nas/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/

/zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes bsngos pas/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bas mnyes shing tshim par bsams la/ mchod pas mchod de 'phrin las bcol nas rdo rje 'chang gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams skyong bar bka' bsgos pa bzhin zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma dam tshig can khyed rnams kyis/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas sgrub cing mchod pa dang 'jug cing dbang blang ba la dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams kyis bsrung zhing bskyab pa dang / byang chub ma thob kyi bar du sdong grogs mdzod cig dkyil 'khor chen por lta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po'i gnod pa dang / gdug pa'i bsam pa 'chang ba rnams 'dir ma 'dug par song zhig gshegs su gsol te 'bud dkrol dang bcas pas gtor ma dor bar bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi khang par zhugs te/ dril bu sil zhing yi ge brgya pa brjod la/ dkyil 'khor la g.yas phyogs su lan gsum du bskor bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba'o/ /de nas bdag nyid 'jug pa'i phyir/ dngos sam yid kyis nub phyogs su song la/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas nas/ shar sgo phye bar bsams la oṃ badz+ra ud gha ṭa yā sa mā ya pra be shā ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas shar sgo dbye'o/ /de bzhin du byang nas lho dang / shar nas nub dang / lho nas byang gi sgo phye la/ rang nyid shar phyogs su gnas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla ma dang tha mi dad bsam la/ bla ma'i bya ba dang / slob ma'i bya ba rnams dngos su rang gis bya zhing / gtso bo las chad pa'i he ru ka phyag gnyis pas dbang rdzas ster ba sogs las kyi rdo rje'i bya ba rnams byed par bsams nas/ phyi dang nang gi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyi/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa blang ngo / /de nas rang thal mo sbyar te/

slob ma la gzhug pa'i phyir/ bden pa'i stobs brjod par bya ste/ shes rab thabs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa/ /bden pa de yi mgon bdag la/ /khyed kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzad/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes/ /bden pa de yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'o/ /de nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams tsa ru'i bza' bas tshim par byas nas/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ bla ma lha la gsol btab dang / /gdong g.yog bcing dang 'phreng ba sbyin/ /gsang dang byin rlabs 'dod pa dri/ /byang chub sems gnyis bskyed pa dang / /gsang bar gdams nas nang du gzhug /phyi yi 'jug pa rnam pa bcu/ /de la thog mar kha dang gdong dag par bkrus pa'i slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol lam yol ba'i phyi rol du rim bzhin 'khod de/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du song bas thal mo sbyar nas/ bla ma la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ ma mā ki dang rab sbyor ba'i/ /dga' chen khyed bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /bla mas kyang / slob ma gzhug pa'i don du/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'od gsal ba las yang dag byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen po/ /gzugs brnyan gyi ni dpe yang de/

/dkyil 'khor pas ni de dang mtshungs/ /bden pa 'di yis slob ma rnams/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dag tu gzhug /'khor lo rdzu 'phrul ma lus pa/ /mthong nas sdig pa ma lus spong / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rdo rje ye shes sgrub byed pa/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / /dam tshig dran pas zhugs pa la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad stsol/ /ces lan gsum gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas sngon chad ma rig pa dang sred pa'i dbang du gyur pas/ dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba mtshon pa'i phyir/ dar dmar po la oṃ tsak+ṣur bhan+dha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐/ pra we sha bha ga wan mahā su kha mok+ṣa pu ram̐ sarba sid+dhi su kha pra dham̐ pa ra ma su kha ta ma si dha dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥpra si dh+ya swa/ zhes pa mngon par bsngags pas gdong bcing / slob ma rnams rnam par snang mdzad du bskyed la a khaṃ wā+e ra hūm̐ zhes brjod cing me tog gi phreng ba re yang gtad/ bighan+na ta krid kyi sngags brjod cing las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus bsangs la/ lce'i steng du bdud rtsi sbyin cing / yi ge gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas slob ma snod du rung mi rung brtag pa'i phyir/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /zhes dris shing / des kyang / skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes lan btab/ des bu la ci zhig bya/ /zhes dris pa'i lan du/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes lan 'debs su gzhug go /de ltar snod du rung bar gyur pa'i slob ma'i sems kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi sems su byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ slob ma'i snying gi nang du/ a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems su dmigs pa'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse mo lnga pa 'od 'phro ba don dam byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor bsgom du bcug la/

snying khar slob dpon gyi rdo rje bzhag nas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ud pa dā ya mi su ra te sa ma ya satwam̐ ho/ sid+dhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ zhes pas sems bskyed la/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing / dad pa dang mi ldan pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsang bar gdams nas/ sgo ba bzhi la rang 'dra ba'i sprul pa 'phros pas/ slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi nang du bcug par bsam zhing sgo ba bzhi'i sngags sam/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ zhes brjod nas/ slob ma rnams rdo rje la 'dzin du bcug ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i mdun du bzhag par mos zhig ces bsgo/ yol ba'i phyi rol gyi cho ga'o/ /de nas nang du 'jug pa'i cho ga la/ phyag 'tshal ba dang sdom pa sbyin/ /dam la bzhag dang ye shes dbab/ /me tog dor dang dkyil 'khor bstan/ /nang du 'jug pa rnam pa drug /de la thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi khang par zhugs pa'i slob mas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la rim gyis phyag byas te/ shar phyogs nas mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ pus mo gnyis sa la btsugs nas thal mo spyi bor sbyar te oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pa s+d+yā nā ya at+mā naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra adhi tiṣ+ṭha swā māṃ zhes brjod nas/ spyi bo sa la gtugs pa'i phyag byas par bsams/ de nas lho phyogs nas rin 'byung gi nga rgyal dang ldan pas thal mo snying khar sbyar nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka yā at+mā naṃ nir+yā ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ zhes brjod nas/ dpral ba sa la gtugs pa'i phyag byas par bsam/

nub phyogs nas 'od dpag tu med pa'i nga rgyal gyis thal mo dpral bar sbyar nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra bar ta nā ya at+mā naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharmā pra wa ra ta ya māṃ/ zhes brjod nas kha sa la gtugs pa'i phyag byas par bsam/ de nas byang phyogs nas don yod grub pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karmā ṇi at+mā naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karmā ku ru māṃ/ zhes brjod nas mgo bo sa la gtugs pa'i phyag byas par bsam mo/ /de nas sta gon gyi skabs ltar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems dang / dam tshig dang sdom pa rgyas par byin pa'am/ yang na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum brjod pa tsam gyis byang chub kyi sems sbyin no/ /de nas ye shes dbab pa gsang du gzhug pa'i phyir/ dam la bzhag pa byas te/ slob ma rnams rdo rje bsdams pa las/ gung mo gnyis mnyam pa brkyangs pas me tog gi phreng ba gzung ba/ rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgya bcings nas/ sa ma ya satwam̐ zhes brjod du bcug la/ slob dpon gyis kyang phyag rgya de nyid slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag cing / oṃ sa twa badz+ri ni a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maṃ hūm̐/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ye shes gang gi khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes ngas khyod la bskyed par bya'i/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyis mdun du smra bar ma byed cig khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ zhes brjod pas phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'o/ /de nas phyag rgya de nyid snying khar gtugs la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyis/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/

gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /zhes brjod nas/ yang phyag de nyid spyi bor gtugs la/ 'di ni khyed kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na/ 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod pa ni nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'o/ /de nas thod par gnas pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mngon par bsngags pa 'thung du bcug la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na 'grub pa yi/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu thungs shig /oṃ badz+ra u da kaṭhaḥzhes brjod pa ni phan yon dang nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'o/ /de nas slob ma'i lag pa g.yas pa nas bzung ba'am/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng phyin chad khyod kyis phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces brjod pa gang yin pa de bya dgos so/ /khyod kyi nga la brnyas par ma byed cig gal te byas na/ mi bde ba ma spangs par shi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re/ zhes brjod pa ni/ slob dpon gyi bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam pa la bzhag pa'o/ /de nas ye shes dbab pa'i phyir/ slob mas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab par mdzod cig ces lan gsum brjod du gzhug go /de nas slob ma rnams tsog pur gnas te/ rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgya snying khar 'chang du bcug la/ mngon byang lngas slob ma 'od dpag tu med par bskyed nas/ yan lag thams cad la yi ge a dmar po bkod de/ lus kyi nang stong par bsgom pa'i snying khar/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ lte bar baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ 'doms su ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/

rkang pa'i 'og tu yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang khu gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ rkang pa'i mthil du dzhaiḥdamar po me'i rang bzhin/ snying gi nang du hūm̐ sngon mo/ mgrin par a dmar po/ spyi bor ham̐ dkar po rnams dmigs nas/ 'og gi rlung g.yos pas/ dzhaiḥganyis po me 'bar ba'i rkang pa'i nang nas song ste/ 'doms kyi me'i dkyil 'khor dang 'dres nas cher 'bar bas/ lus thams cad gang nas sdig pa dang rnam rtog thams cad bsregs/ lto ba'i chu khol zhing snying kha'i sa bsregs te hūm̐ la sogs pa'i yi ge gsum las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyud bskul nas/ slob ma'i lus la char chen po ltar babs te ro gcig tu gyur pas/ lus ngag yid gsum/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgya slob ma'i snying khar bzhag la/ 'di khyod dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya gang / /rdo rje ye shes bla na med/ /ding ni khyod la 'bebs par mdzad/ /oṃ badz+ra a we sha ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥ.aḥzhes brjod nas/ gu gul gyis bdug cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas dbab bo/ /gal te ma phebs pa'am phebs kyang brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ hūm̐ a ha'i yi ge gsum rim pa bzhin du/ mi bskyod pa 'od dpag med/ rnam snang yab yum du dmigs te snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras rigs gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bkug ste zhal du zhugs nas sku'i dbyibs brgyud de sbyor mtshams nas/ byang sems sngo dmar dkar po'i rnam par babs nas/ lus thams cad khengs nas/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams nas/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ a we sha ya staṃ bha ya ra ra ra/ tsā la ya tsā la ya hūm̐ aḥhaḥdzhaiḥzhes drag tu brjod cing dbab bo/ /phebs na 'dar ba dang 'phar la sogs pa'i sku'i rtags/

smra ba dang rgod pa sogs gsung gi rtags/ bde ba dang mi rtog pa sogs thugs kyi rtags 'byung ngo / /de nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod pas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas me tog dor bar bya ba'i phyir/ slob mas/ bla ma la phyag dang me tog phul ba sngon du 'gro bas/ rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgyas me tog gi phreng ba bzung nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su langs nas 'khod pa la/ ltas brtag pa'i phyir nam mkha'i kha dog dris te/ dkar por snang bas zhi ba/ ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang / nag po mngon spyod/ ljang khu dang khra bos 'phrin las sna tshogs 'grub par lung bstan la/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas 'di skad ces/ yang dag dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /bsod nams ji bzhin lha rnams kyi/ /rigs kyi rim pa de bzhin shog /ji ltar 'di ni 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /gang gi rigs kyi snod gyur dang / /ji lta'i bsod nams mthu yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces bden pa'i stobs brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor chen po 'di'i lha sum bcu so gnyis po thams cad gtso bo gcig gi ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul yin pas bzang ngan med kyi/ rang gi rigs kyi lha gang yin pa de la 'bab par gyur cig snyam pa gyis/ me tog dor cig ces sgos la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ḍhi ḍo me bha wa shā shwa to me bha wa hri da ya me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi me pra ya ts+tsha hūm̐ haḥhaḥhaḥhaḥho oṃ aḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ pra ti ts+tsha ku su ma an dza li nā tha hoḥzhes pa'am/ oṃ pra tits+tsha badz+ra hoḥzhes brjod de/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dor nas/ gang la phog pa de'i rigs su shes par bya zhing / de'i gnas kyis dngos grub kyi mtshan ma shes par bya ste/ gtsug tor la phog pas mchog gi dngos grub dang / zhal la sngags kyi dngos grub dang / sku la phog pas grub pa brgyad dang /

sku dang nye bas dngos grub myur zhing / ring bas ring la/ gnyis kyi bar du lhung na gang nye ba'i phyogs su bsdu zhing / gal te de dag la ma phog na lan gsum bskyar ro/ /gsum pa la yang ma phog na/ skal pa med pa'i phyir/ phyir gtang ngo / /skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis me tog de nyid kyis dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / lha de'i sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i pra ti ghih+ṇa dam̐/ i maṃ sa twa mahā ba la zhes brjod nas mgo la bcing ngo / /me tog dor ba'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i phyir/ slob ma'i mig 'bras gnyis oṃ du bsgom du bcug la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /he badz+ra pa sh+ya zhes brjod nas gdong g.yogs bkrol la/ dkyil 'khor 'di la ltos shig dang / /da ni dad pa rab du bskyed/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /zhes brjod nas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas par bstan par bya'o/ /de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ dang po bum pa'i dbang yin te/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang yin no/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes te/ /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /dang po bum pa'i dbang la yang / /chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang / /dril bu me dang me long dang / /brtul zhugs rdo rje slob dpon dang / /rjes gnang dang ni lung bstan dang / /de bzhin du ni dbugs dbyung ba/ /bcu gsum bum pa'i dbang yin no/ /de la thog mar dkyil 'khor du bcug pa'i slob ma rnams kyis/ bla ma la phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /ces gsol ba 'debs su bcug nas/ mdun du gnas pa la/

dkyil 'khor gyi khro bo las khro bo'i sprul pa du ma spros pas/ slob ma'i bgegs dang byur rnams bsal bar bsam zhing / bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags dang / las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus bsangs la/ byur dang skal ba ngan pa rnams til lam yungs kar la bstim la/ g.yas phyogs nas bskor zhing / oṃ sarba pā pam̐ da ha na badz+rā ya badz+ra swa s+ya sarba pa paṃ da ha na ye swāhā/ zhes brjod la mer dor nas/ bgegs mthar byed kyis mngon par bsngags pa'i chu/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis blangs pas/ g.yon nas bskor zhing / dri ma rnams bkrus par bsams la/ hūm̐ ṭa ṭi ṭa phaṭ ces brjod nas dor la/ sta gon gyi skabs ltar skyor chu blud do/ /de nas slob dpon rang zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum du dmigs te/ bum chus bsangs pa'i slob ma zhal du zhugs/ 'dod chags chen po'i mes bzhu ba/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi bha gar babs pa'i thig le hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa mi bskyod par yab yum du gyur pa la/ bla ma'i snying kha'i sa bon gyis/ phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la mchod de/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba bskyab pa'i ched du dbang / /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal/ /de ltar 'di la bstsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ 'dir dbang rdzas dang bdag bskyed la slob ma gnyis gnyis pa'i/ rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa/ 'dod chags chen po'i mes zhu ba/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs te/ rdo rje'i lam nas thon pa'i bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur bar bsam pa ni/ nang ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang ngo / /de nas sbyor mtshams nas phyung nas/ lus dkyil gsal btab ste/ ye shes pa bstim pa la/ phyi'i dbang bskur bar bya ste/ de yang rnam rgyal bum pas bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ dang rdo rje mi bskyod par yab yum du bskyed pa gyur pa la/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/

ye shes pa bcug dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa ste mchod la/ de zhu ba bum pa'i chur bltas la/ dpon slob gnyis kas dkyil 'khor gyi lha nam mkha'i khams gang bar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas slob ma'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa'i oṃ badz+ra a dar sha dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ brtan pa'i phyir/ char 'bebs par bsams nas/ dngos su slob dpon las kyi rdo rje dang bcas pas bum pa gzung zhing / til gyi gang bu ltar gang ba'i/ /rgyal ba bum pa 'dzin pa yis/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /de ltar shes nas yid bder gyis/ /zhes brjod la/ bum pa'i kha rgyan gyis rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu blangs nas spyi bor blug cing / dbang bskur rdo rje chen po 'di/ /khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum pa'i/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ mahā su kha badz+ra sa twa a bhi ṣe ka toṃ a bhi ṣi ñtsa mi sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti twe no pa dhi ñdzo bha ba/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun kyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /ma lus sems can skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyed la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rdo rje'i rigs dang ldan/ /sdang bas zil mnan skye bo rnam par sbyong byed pa/ /mi bskyod mgon po zhes bya mtshan gsol de yis ni/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyed la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus 'khor lo'i rigs dang ldan/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtag 'phrog cing /

/rmongs pa zil mnan skye bo yongs su sbyong mdzad pa/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rin chen rigs dang ldan/ /phong ba'i sdug bsngal yongs su sgrol bar rab brtson zhing / /khengs pa zil mnan 'gro ba yongs su sbyong mdzad pa/ bkra shis des ni de ring khyed la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus pad+ma'i rigs dang ldan/ /'jig rten dbang phyug srid pa'i drwa ba 'joms pa po/ /chags pas zil mnan 'gro ba yongs su sbyong mdzad pa/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus las kyi rigs dang ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid log par lta ba nges par spong / /de sbyor thabs ston de ni yongs su sel mdzad pa/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ su ra ta satwaṃ a haṃ zhes brjod cing / bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang / sdig sgrib thams cad dag mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam nas/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod de/ khyod kyi dbang lnga las chu'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga las zhe sdang gi dri ma sbyangs/ phung po lnga las rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga las chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon sum du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga las mi bskyod pa'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag mi bskyod pa dang de dang 'brel pa'i las bsgrub pa la dbang ngo zhes don lngas rtogs pa bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ slob ma yid kyis sam dngos su dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byed du bcug nas/ bde ba chen po 'dod chags che/ /rdo rje chen po nor che ba/ /shes rab chen po ye shes che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' deng bdag bsgrub/

/sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje che/ /dngos grub kun gyi bde ster ba/ /kun gyi dbang bskur kun don du/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur bla na med/ /e ma ho/ dang po'i sangs rgyas don dam sku can rgyal/ /thar pa chos nor 'dod pa ster mdzad rgyal/ /ye shes lnga dang dga' ldan rang bzhin rgyal/ /mgon po bde chen phyag na rdo rje rgyal/ /zhes pa'i glu 'di blangs nas/ stan la 'dug tu bcug la/ gong du bstan pa dang mtshungs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang ldan pas/ rin 'byung man la bdag dang dbang rdzas gnyis ka'i sku gsung thugs sam gnas lnga byin rlabs tsam bya/ swā dang rin po che las slob ma rin 'byung du bskyed cing / dbang rdzas dbu rgyan yang stong pa'i ngang las rin 'byung du bskyed/ zhu ba las byung ba'i/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan du bltas la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che/ /dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste/ /rin chen kun gyi mchog 'gro bas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku ṭa pū dza ya a tī shā yā mi āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas/ dbu rgyan mgo bo la bskon la/ rdo rje thal sbyar mthe bong dag /dpa' bo skyil krung nyid du bskum/ /bar ma mchog gi yan lag brkyang / /rtse mo rtse mo mnyam par sbyar/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi phyag rgyar bshad/ /phyag rgya 'dis slob ma'i spyi bor bcings la/ oṃ badz+ra dhā tu i shwa ra a bh-i ṣiñtsa a/ zhes brjod la/ spyi bor hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgya de nyid dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ satwa badz+rī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ oṃ las rnam snang / phyag rgya de nyid las gung mo'i tshigs dbus ma bcag pa/ rin po che'i rnam par byas pa rin chen rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag la/ oṃ rat+na badz+rī a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐ zhes brjod de/ swā las rin 'byung / de nyid las gung mo pad+ma'i rnam par byas pa chos kyi rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya ltag par bcings la/

oṃ dharma badz+rī a bhi ṣiñtsa hriḥzhes brjod de/ a las 'od dpag tu med pa/ de nyid las dbus ma'i tshigs dang po bcag pa/ las kyi rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya rna ba g.yon du bcings la/ oṃ karma badz+rī a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥzhes brjod de/ ha las don yod grub pa bsam mo/ /de nas dpral bar mnyam pa'i thal mo sbyar ba phye nas/ thal mo gnyis g.yas dang g.yon du brkyang pa'i tshul du bya zhing oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥzhes brjod nas dar dpyangs kyi dbang byin la/ sngar gyi rang rang gi bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dang / sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur zhes sogs kyis chu'i dbang bskur zhing / dri ma dag rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa la/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod de/ rin 'byung gi rang bzhin cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma sbyangs/ tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin 'byung gi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag rin 'byung dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang bar bya'o zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang ldan pa las a dang pad+ma las slob ma 'od dpag tu med par bskyed cing rdo rje stong pa'i ngang las 'od dpag tu med par bskyed la/ mchod cing zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer bltas la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /mi phyed rdo rje 'od gsal ba/ /dam chos 'byung ba'i snod gyur pa/ /rdo rje chos kyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa dhi twam̐/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+rā sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa satwaṃ dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hīḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐ zhes brjod de/ slob ma'i snying kha dang /

lkog ma dang / gtsug tor du reg la lag pa g.yas su gtad/ de kyang lha'i nga rgyal brtan pas snyems pa'i tshul gyis bzung / de nyid brtan par bya ba'i phyir du/ sngar gyi bkra shis sogs brjod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i chu'i dbang bskur/ 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ 'od dpag tu med pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag tu med pa'i sa bon dang / bag chags rgyud la bzhag 'od dpag tu med pa dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang ldan pas/ ha dang ral gri de las/ slob ma don yod grub par bskyed cing / stong pa'i ngang las dril bu don grub tu bskyed cing mchod de zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur bltas te/ slob dpon gyis bkrol nas/ zla ba'i 'od can ye shes sku mnga' rgyal ba'i cod pan 'dzin pa pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gdug pa rnams ni 'dul ba'i don du srid gsum 'dul mdzad bsdigs pa'i de nyid rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bskul phyir de kho na nyid so sor sgrogs pa'i chos nyid dril bu 'khrol/ /dngos po kun gyi ngo bo ma lus stong pa'i bcom ldan gang yin de ni rgyal gyur cig /me long gi ni gzugs brnyan dang / /rmi lam sgyu ma chu bur dang / /mig 'khrul 'dra ba sus mthong pa/ /de ni mnga' bdag tu bshad do/ /zhes brjod nas/ lag pa g.yon du gtad pas/ des kyang dkrol te dku g.yon par bkan te bzung la g.yas pas rdo rje snyems pa'i tshul gyis gzung ste/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya zhes sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod la oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ.aḥbadag gis bcom ldan bzung lags kyis/ /bcom ldan bdag la nye bar mdzod/ /ces brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis/

oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hī/ sa ma ya satwaṃ zhes brjod nas/ bkra shis sogs brjod pas chu'i dbang bskur/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod de/ don grub kyi rang bzhin dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog gi dri ma dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don grub kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag don grub dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang ngo zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /de nas ming gi dbang bskur ba ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang ldan pas/ oṃ dang 'khor lo las slob ma rnam snang du bskyed cing / spyi bo yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa'i rnam snang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa slob ma'i lus la thim par bsams nas/ rdo rje dril bu rtse sprad de spyi bor gtugs la oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka te heḥshrī che ge mo/ badz+ra ta thā ga ta sa ma ya sid+dhi sa ma ya satwam̐/ bhūr bhū waḥswaḥ.aḥzhes brjod la/ che ge mo zhes pa'i gnas su rigs dang mthun pa'i ming btags te/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs yin na bzhad pa dang / sgeg pa dang / gnyis med dang / mi phyed pa dang / dga' rab dang / rol pa'i rdo rje zhes dang / rnam snang gi rigs la/ gti mug dang / oṃ mdzad dang / rtag pa dang / sgyu 'phrul rdo rje zhes dang / rin 'byung la/ yid bzhin nor bu dang / mkha' dang / gzi brjid rdo rje zhes dang / 'od dpag med la/ 'dod chags dang / spyan ras gzigs dang / chos dang / pad+ma'i rdo rje zhes dang / don grub la rta mchog dang / dam tshig dang / las kyi rdo rje zhes sogs mgo ru dpal dang / mjug tu rdo rje btags pa'o/ /lha mo la mi bskyod pa'i rigs la rdo rje bdag med ma dang / lag ma dang / phreng ba ma dang / 'byung gnas ma dang / rnam snang gi rigs la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang /

sgeg mo la sogs pa dang / rin 'byung gi rigs la/ rdo rje do shal ma dang / dbugs dbyung ma dang / 'bar ma dang / phreng ba ma dang / pad+ma'i rigs la/ rdo rje chags pa ma dang / dbyangs ma dang / blo gros ma dang / gos dkar po la sogs pa dang / don grub kyi rigs la rdo rje snye ma dang / sgyu 'phrul ma dang / rgod ma dang / sgrol ma la sogs pa mgor rdo rje sbyar ba'i ming btags te/ bkra shis brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas chu'i dbang bskur nas/ rnam snang gi rgyas btab ste mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ rnam snang gi rang bzhin ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug gi dri ma dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon sum du byas/ rnam snang gi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag rnam snang dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang bar byos zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /de nas/ thun mong gi rtogs pa bskyed pa ni/ sangs rgyas lnga ni rnam dag 'di/ /dbang bskur lnga ni thob pa'i rgyu/ /ma rig pa ni bsal nas ni/ /ye shes lnga ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod nas/ de'i don/ dbang 'di rnams/ sbyang gzhi phung po lnga dang nyon mongs pa lnga sbyong zhing / thob bya rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga mngon du byed pa rigs pa'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i dbang yin pa'i phyir/ rig pa'i dbang zhes bya ste/ rang gi rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa lngar byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ snang ba thams cad rigs lngar blta bar bya ste/ dngos po gang dang gang snang ba/ /gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rnam dag la/ /sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar gyis/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid mngon du bya ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa me long gi dbang dang / rdo rje'i brtul zhugs stabs gcig tu sbyin par bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang ldan pas hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

de las slob ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug par bskyed cing / a las dbang rdzas me long reg rdo rje mar dkar mo rdo rje sems dpa' bzhin bskyed nas/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i me long slob ma la bstan la/ brjod dang gzung 'dzin rnams spangs shing / /dag cing gsal la dri ma med/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /rang lha'i gzugs 'di shes par gyis/ /oṃ pra ti bhi m+bha a dar+sha bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥzhes brjod nas/ chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar shes par gyis shig ces rtogs pa bskyed do/ /de nas rdo rje hūm̐ la rdo rje sems par sku mdog dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug par bskyed/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par gtad nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na bsnams/ /khyed kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa twaṃ dhā ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hīḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod do/ /des kyang blangs nas hūm̐ zhes brjod cing / lan gsum gsor nas/ snying khar gzung la/ snying kha'i nang du rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'/ thugs khar rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rdo rjer bsgom du bcug nas/ bkra shis brjod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i chu'i dbang bskur te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyas btab la/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma me long gi dbang thob yul yul can la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ chos can dang chos nyid gnas gyur/ thog ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems mngon du byas/ drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag rdor sems dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/

/de rnams ni thun mong ba slob ma'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /de nas thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la stsol/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon gyis ni las rnams dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom dang gsang ba bla med stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rtag tu slob dpon bdag gyur gsungs/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas/ slob dpon du 'os pa'i slob ma gcig dbang stegs seng ge'i khri'i steng du bzhag la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang ldan pas rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa bskyed pa la/ dam tshig gsum sbyin par bya ste/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi dam tshig tu byin gyis brlabs pa bzung nas/ sngar gyi rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi tshigs bcad dang sngags brjod de byin la rdo rje'i de kho na nyid brjod de/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun gyi bdag /rdo rje snye ma'i bdag po bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /zhes brjod la/ rdo rje 'di ni/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems kun tu bzang po de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga po thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin yin pas/ 'dis byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ rang gi sems kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor shes par bya'o/ /zhes brjod/ slob mas/ mahā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes lan gsum brjod cing snying khar bzung ngo / /de nas a las byung ba'i dril bu/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa gzung nas/

'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyi kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /a zhes brjod nas byin la/ dril bu'i de kho na nyid/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis bdag /ngo bo nyid kyi srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dbang po'i sems ldan pa/ /srid pa dam par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod nas/ dril bu 'di ni srid pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin yin pas/ 'dis byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ rang gi ngag kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /zhes brjod/ slob mas/ badz+ra ghan+ḍe a zhes brjod nas bkrol la/ dku g.yon par snyems pa'i tshul gyis gzung ngo / /de'i rjes su/ yid kyi lus ni brtan bya'i phyir/ /phyag rgya dam tshig ces su bshad/ /lus kun brtan par byed pas na/ /de phyir phyag rgya zhes su bsgrags/ /zhes brjod la/ slob ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'khyud par bsams la/ rdo rje dril bus 'khyud pa'i stangs ka byed du bcug ste/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes brjod la rdo rje 'chang chen po phyag rgya lo bcu drug ma'i rnam pas 'khyud pa 'di ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i dam tshig yin pas/ 'dis byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ rang gi lus kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i ngo bor shes par bya'o zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis bkug pa'i lha tshogs nam mkha' gang bas/ sngar bzhin dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad yongs su rdzogs pa'am yang na dang po sngon du 'gro ba'i/

dbang bskur rdo rje chen po sogs brjod cing chu dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pa'i rgyas btab/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod de/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā zhes brjod nas/ slob ma'i spyi bor me tog gi phreng ba bzhag go /brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ slob dpon gyis yi ge brgya pa brjod pa'i rjes la/ slob mas kyang bzla bar bya'o/ /de ltar rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang thob pas/ de kho na nyid bstan pa'i snod du gyur pas/ de kho na nyid bstan par bya ste/ thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid ni/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam par dag pas dkyil 'khor gyi tshad khru bcu gnyis pa'o/ /bden pa bzhi rnam par dag pas ngos bzhi/ tshad med bzhi rnam par dag pas grwa bzhi/ 'byung ba bzhi dag pas sgo bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dag pas sgo khyud bzhi/ dbang po lnga dag pas rtsig pa lnga/ bsam gtan bzhi dag pas rta babs bzhi/ gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin rnam par dag pas 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ phar phyin bcu dag pas pha gu/ sgom spang spangs pa dag pas drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa/ dbang bcu dag pas bha ku li/ dge ba bcu dag pas mda' yab/ rnam par thar pa brgyad dag pas dkyil 'khor nang ma'i mtha' re mig brgyad kyis bskor ba/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad dag pas ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ chos kyi de kho na nyid ston pa'i brdar rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'o/ /lha'i de kho na nyid ni/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnam par dag pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo dbus kyi mi bskyod pa/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag pa dang / me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo shar gyi rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa dang / mnyam nyid ye shes kyi ngo bo lho'i rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa dang / so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo nub kyi 'od dpag tu med pa/

'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag pa dang / bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo byang gi don yod grub pa/ sa'i khams rnam par dag pa dang / byams pa tshad med pa'i ngo bo re mig nang ma'i shar lho'i spyan ma/ chu'i khams rnam par dag pa dang / snying rje tshad med pa'i ngo bo lho nub kyi mā ma ki me'i khams rnam par dag pa dang / dga' ba tshad med pa'i ngo bo nub byang gi gos dkar mo/ rlung gi khams rnam par dag pa dang / btang snyoms tshad med pa'i ngo bo byang shar gyi sgrol ma/ gzugs rnam par dag pa re mig gnyis par shar lho'i gzugs rdo rje ma/ sgra rnam par dag pa lho nub kyi sgra rdo rje ma/ dri rnam par dag pa nub byang gi dri rdo rje ma/ ro rnam par dag pa byang shar gyi ro rdo rje ma/ reg rnam par dag pa dbus kyi reg rdo rje ma/ rtsa rgyus rnam par dag pa dang zag pa med pa'i mngon shes kyi ngo bo shar gyi snam bu'i g.yas phyogs kyi byams pa/ mig rnam par dag pa dang / mig gi mngon shes kyi ngo bo g.yon phyogs kyi sa'i snying po/ rna ba rnam par dag pa dang / rna ba'i mngon shes kyi ngo bo lho'i snam bu'i g.yas phyogs kyi phyag na rdo rje/ sna rnam par dag pa dang / sna'i mngon shes kyi ngo bo g.yon phyogs kyi nam mkha'i snying po/ lce rnam par dag pa dang / lce'i mngon shes kyi ngo bo nub kyi snam bu'i g.yas phyogs kyi 'jig rten dbang phyug yid rnam pa dag pa dang / gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyi ngo bo g.yon gyi 'jam dpal/ lus rnam par dag pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes kyi ngo bo byang gi snam bu'i g.yas phyogs kyi sgrib sel/ tshigs rnam par dag pa dang / sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mngon shes kyi ngo bo g.yon phyogs kyi kun tu bzang po/ lag pa g.yas pa rnam par dag pa dang / sbyin pa'i ngo bo shar sgo'i gshin rje gshed/ lag pa g.yon pa rnam par dag pa dang / snyan smra'i ngo bo lho'i sgo'i gzhan gyis mi thub pa/

kha rnam par dag pa dang / don spyod kyi ngo bo nub sgo'i rta mgrin/ rdo rje rnam par dag pa dang / don mthun gyi ngo bo byang sgo'i bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ dpung pa g.yas rnam par dag pa shar lho'i mi g.yo ba/ dpung pa g.yon rnam par dag pa lho nub kyi 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ pus mo g.yas rnam par dag pa nub byang gi dbyug sngon can/ pus mo g.yon rnam par dag pa byang shar gyi stobs po che/ spyi gtsug rnam par dag pa steng gi 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ rkang mthil rnam par dag pa 'og gi gnod mdzes so/ /de ltar phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid bshad nas/ nang lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis lus la rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par gnas par bshad de/ lus ni gzhal yas khang du gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yang dag brten/ /zur bzhi pa ni mdun rgyab dang / /g.yas dang g.yon gyi dbye bas so/ /steng 'og sgo yi dbye ba yis/ /sgo bzhi zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /sna yi rtse mo'i dbyibs kyis ni/ /rta babs bzhir ni brjod par bya/ /dra ba rgyu mar yang dag bshad/ /rgyus par gyur pa drwa ba phyed/ /ma ni zla ba phyed pa dang / /bum pa lto bar yang dag bshad/ /rje ngar brla sbom lag ngar ni/ /ka ba brgyad du yang dag bshad/ /mig gi rnam shes me long sogs/ /sgra yi rnam shes ba dan dang / /rna yi rnam shes me tog phreng / /rin chen pha gu spyan rnams so/ /lus kyi rnam shes dar 'phan dang / /yid kyi rnam shes ri dwags so/ /mig ni 'khor lo'i mtshan ma dang / /rna ba kun nas rdo rje rnams/ /sna ni ba dan du ni bshad/ /lce ni dril bu ru ni gsungs/ /rnga yab la sogs rnam dag pa/ /lus kyi tshogs zhes bya bar bshad/ /yid ni dbus kyi pad mar gsungs/ /rnam rtog rlung ni yang dag brten/ /ye shes lnga ni rnam dag pa/ /re khā lngar ni yang dag brjod/ /phung po lnga ni yang dag lnga/

/rnam dag kha dog lnga ni byed/ /ces bya ba dang / /rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas/ /dang po gzugs kyi phung po ni/ /sku yi rdo rje'i yang dag bzhugs/ /de bzhin nam mkha'i rdo rje ni/ /tshor ba yi ni phung por bzhugs/ /bcom ldan gsung gi rdo rje ni/ /'du shes kyi ni phung po bzhugs/ /las rnams kun gyi rdo rje ni/ /'du byed kyi ni phung por bzhugs/ /bcom ldan thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /rnam shes phung por yang dag bzhugs/ /yang / 'di yi sha sogs sa khams la/ /bcom ldan 'das yum spyan bzhugs so/ /khrag sogs chu yi khams la ni/ /bcom ldan 'das yum mā ma bzhugs/ /dro ba la sogs me khams la/ /bcom ldan 'das yum gos dkar bzhugs/ /bskyod pa la sogs rlung khams la/ /bcom ldan 'das yum sgrol ma bzhugs/ /de yi mig dbang gnyis la ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sa snying ngo / /de yi rna ba'i dbang gnyis la/ bde gshegs phyag na rdo rje 'o/ /de yi sna bug gnyis na ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i mdzod/ /de yi lce dbang la bzhugs pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang / /de yi yid kyi dbang po la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jam dbyangs bzhugs/ /khams bzhi'i rang bzhin gong bu ni/ /lus zhes bya bar brtags pa la/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam sel ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de bzhugs so/ /lus kyi tshigs ni thams cad la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu bzang / /lus kyi rtsa rgyus thams cad la/ /de bzhin gshegs la byams pa 'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i rtsa bar ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gshin rje gshed/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i rtsa bar ni/ /bde gshegs gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /kha yi pad mor bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rta mgrin no/ /gsang bar gnas su bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /dpung pa g.yas par bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi g.yo mgon/ /dpung pa g.yon par bzhugs pa ni/

/de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /pus mo g.yas par bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbyug pa sngo/ /pus mo g.yon par bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs po che/ /gang gi spyi gtsug steng bzhugs pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor los bsgyur/ /rkang pa'i 'og tu bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gnod mdzes te/ /lus ni 'di nyid kun la 'dor/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bzhugs/ /zhes brjod nas/ gzhal yas khang gi de kho na nyid kyi lam gyi chos dang / lha'i de kho na nyid kyis 'bras bu'i chos mtshon cing / thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus la tshang la/ ji ltar slob dpon gyis lus la tshang ba de bzhin du/ dbang bskur thob pa'i slob ma khyed rnams la yang tshang ngo zhes bshad par bya'o/ /de nas rjes gnang sbyin par bya ste/ sngags dang slob dpon bya ba dang / /lha rnams mchod dang sems can don/ /chos 'chad pa ste rjes gnang lnga/ /de la sngags kyi rjes gnang ni/ rjes bzlos byed du bcug la/ bla ma'i thugs kha'i sngags phreng las chad pa'i/ sngags phreng gnyis pa bla ma'i zhal nas 'thon/ slob ma'i khar zhugs te/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' bskor du 'khod par bsams la/ gtso bo'i snying po lan gsum bzlas pa'i rjes su/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /snying po yi ni ye shes mchog /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdus pa ni/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag par bcang / /zhes brjod la lha'i rnal 'byor yang sbyin no/ gtso bo 'phos ba'i rim pa'o/ /de nas slob mas me tog gi phreng ba phul la/ bcom ldan bdag gi bzung lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la mnyes par mdzod/ /zhes gsol ba gdab/ bla mas me tog phreng pa de nyid slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'di la brtsal lags kyi/ /'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod do/ de nas slon dpon gyi bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba ni/

phreng ba la sogs dbang rnams kyi/ /dbang bskur nga yis byin pa yis/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam spangs te/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mdun du gnas/ /da ni dkyil 'khor slob dpon te/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par bsngags/ /khyed ni bdud las rnams rgyal te/ /sangs rgyas thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /'jigs pa med pa seng ge'i spyod pa legs spyad pas/ /khyod kyi sems can don rnams byos/ /chos rnams kun la ser sna dang / /sems can don la mi phan gang / /nyams nga shin tu che na yang / /bu khyod kyis ni de mi bya/ /'di la the tshom mi bya ste/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul gyis mchog /mnyam med khyod kyis bsgrags par bya/ /dkyil 'khor legs par bri bya ste/ /slob ma yongs su bsdu bar gyis/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis su/ /slob ma rnams la dbang yang bskur/ /brtul zhugs brtan pas 'jig rten dang / /'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub bsgrub/ gnas lugs kyi /de nyid rigs pa'i sems kyis ni/ /dngos grub de rnams thams cad 'byung / /chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / /dam tshig rnams kyang bskyangs pa dang / /khyed rtag bla ma la gus pas/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du bzo zhes brjod/ /des na byas pa bzo ba yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang khyod la bsrung / /zhes brjod do/ /de nas lha mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ slob ma'i khu tshur gnyis dkur bzhag ste/ sgeg pa ltar byed du bcug ste/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras dang bcas pas rnam rol cing / /rdo rje snye ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dga' ston bde bas mchod pa gyis/ /a zhes brjod/ me tog gi phreng ba dkyil 'khor la 'bul ba'i tshul byed du bcug la/ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang / /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/
