/des ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oṃ zhes brjod/ glu len du bcug la/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya/ /de yi bde gshegs dngos grub ni/ /myur du bde ba myong 'gyur gyi/ /gī zhes brjod/ thal mos gar byed du bcug la/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'dul ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du rgyu bar gyis/ /ho zhes brjod/ spos 'bul du bcug la/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ /hūm̐ zhes brjod/ me tog 'thor du bcug la/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog dor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis/ /bh+rūm̐ zhes brjod/ mar me 'dzin du bcug la/ chos kyi sgron me legs sbar bas/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru/ /sems can ma rig longs pa la/ /chos kyi sgron me gsal bar gyis/ /pra zhes brjod/ dri 'thor du bcug la/ rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bsgos/ /gha zhes brjod/ de nas sems can gyi don bya ba'i rjes gnang la/ thog mar ma rig pa'i ling tog bsal bas sems can gyi don bya bar bstan pa'i phyir/ thur ma'i rjes gnang ni/ gser ram dngul las byas pa'i thur ma'am/ med na rdo rje slob ma'i mig dbye ba'i tshul du byas nas/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /ling tog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hriḥpraṃ zhes brjod/ de ltar ma rig pa'i ling tog bsal bas/ chos thams cad gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar shes par gyis shig zhes bstan pa'i phyir/

me long gi rjes gnang ni/ as sngags pa'i me long bstan te/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas sgra thams cad grag la rang bzhin med par bstan pa'i phyir/ dril bu'i rjes gnang ni/ a las bskyed pa'i dril bu byin la/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dag dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /zhes brjod cing / dkrol du gzhug go /de ltar chos rnams rang bzhin med par shes pas de ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje chen po skyes te/ nyan rang gi sems bskyed khyad du gsad na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes shing rjes su chags par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bstan pa'i phyir/ mda' gzhu'i rjes gnang ni/ ho zhes bya bas mda' gzhu byin la/ phyogs bzhi steng 'og tu 'phen pa'i tshul byed du gzhug cing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rjes su chags par byos shig ces brjod do/ /de ltar chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs pa de yang / sngar ye shes 'bebs pa'i dus kyi nyams myong de yin la/ de yang rdo rje sems dpa' snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur shes par gyis shig ces bstan pa'i phyir/ me long gi rjes snang gnyis pa ni/ yang me long bstan la/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gtso/ /gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems ni 'di yin par shes par gyis shig ces brjod do/ /de ltar rang bzhin med pa'i myong ba skyes pas/

phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pas sems can gyi don bya bar bstan pa'i phyir/ ral gri'i rjes gnang ni/ khaṃ gi bsngags pa'i ral gri byin la/ 'debs pa'i tshul byed du gzhug cing / 'di de kun bzang brtul zhugs te/ /bsam pa sna tshogs rnam dag byed/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /sems can kun gyi don ni byos/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khaḍ+ga dha ra twam̐/ zhes brjod nas/ slob mas kyang dha ra ya mi hūm̐ zhes brjod do/ /de ltar sems can gyi don byed pa la/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor dgos pas/ chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang bya ba ni/ slob ma rnams dbang stegs kyi steng du bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra he tu zhes pa/ 'khor lo bris pa rkang pa'i bar du gzhug oṃ badz+ra bha ṣa raṃ zhes pas lag pa g.yas par dung byin/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe a zhes pas/ g.yon par dril bu byin/ a zhes pas/ lag ngar gnyis kyi steng du gsang ba 'dus pa'i po ti bzhag deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pas/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /sngags spyod sogs su mos pa tsam gyis khyab tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas nas sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du bzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /ces brjod la/ /de nas slob ma rnam snang du bskyed cing / rnam snang zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lo byin la/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /dza ya dza ya sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti pra ba dha ya dharma tsakra zhes brjod/ slob ma rin 'byung du bskyed la/ rin 'byung zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che byin la/

rkang pa dang po gsum sngar dang 'dra zhing / sangs rgyas rin chen rab tu ston/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na sarba dharma bi shud+dha dz+nya na a bhi ṣe ka swa bha oṃ oṃ oṃ zhes brjod/ slob ma 'od dpag tu med par bskyed la/ 'od dpag tu med pa zhu ba las byung ba'i pad+ma byin te/ 'dod chags dag pa rab tu ston/ /oṃ badz+ra dharma sarba dharma bi shud dha dz+nya na rā ka pad+ma da la swa bhā wa hriḥ.aḥzhes brjod do/ /slob ma don grub tu bskyed cing / don grub zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje byin la/ rdo rje'i mchod pa rab tu bskor/ oṃ badz+ra karma sarba dharma bi shud dha dz+nya na sarba pu dza swa bhā wa a zhes brjod nas/ khyod kyis rigs bzhis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la/ rigs de dang de'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor la/ chos kyi dung bus/ sgra sgrogs/ bshad pa gyis shig ces brjod de/ dung 'bud pa dang / dril bu dkrol du gzhug go /de dag ni rjes gnang ngo / /de nas ma 'ongs pa'i dus su sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba lung bstan pa'i phyir/ de ltar sangs rgyas rigs su 'jug /khyod kyi bdag la lung bstan gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug la/ slob dpon gyis shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas chos gos gyon te/ chos gos kyi gra gnyis seng ge'i rna ltar byas pa lag pa g.yon gyis bzung ste/ g.yas pas dril bu bzung la/ skyabs sbyin du byas te/ oṃ/ nga yis 'di ltar lung bstan te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa mchog ni bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro nyid las bton/ /kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sid+dhi sa ma ya satwaṃ/ bhur bhu wa swaḥzhes lung bstan cing / gang la sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'dis lung bstan pa de la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/

/zhes brjod do/ /de nas dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir/ bla ma'i zhal snga nas ni skyes/ /mgon po yang dag bdag dbugs phyung / /zhes gsol ba 'debs su bcug nas/ mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag la/ khyod kyi lam la bslab pa ni 'di dag yin no zhes bstan pa'i phyir/ thog mar lam gyi dbugs dbyung ba ni/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya/ /brdzun gyi tshigs kyang smra bar bya/ /ma byin par yang khyod kyis blang / /gzhan gyi chung ma bsten par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya 'o/ /slob dpon brnyas par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyam pas/ /slob dpon la ni gang brnyas pa/ /des ni sangs rgyas kun brnyas pas/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur/ /de phyir sangs rgyas 'bras 'dod cing / /gus dang ldan pa'i sems can gyis/ bsam yas 'bras bu rtsol ba po/ /'di la 'bad pa kun gyis mchod/ /byang chub go 'phang sla'am ci/ /srid pa sel bar su yis nus/ /gang la skyes shing shi ba med/ /gang zhig las gnyis la nus ldan/ /rdo rje slob dpon med par ni/ /nyon mongs thams cad spong ba dang / /mya ngan 'das zhi go 'phang dang / /phyir mi ldog pa thob mi 'gyur/ /rang gi dam tshig rtag tu bsrung / /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la dbul bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan sems kyis/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /rtag tu rnam rtog med gyur na/ /khyod kyi 'dod pa lnga rnams spyod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun gsungs shing / /bka' lung dam pa rtags pa ste gsungs yi/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa 'di/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /zhes brjod nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs shing mthong ba tsam gyis/ gnas skabs sdig pa kun las grol zhing / mthar thug srid pa'i sdug bsngal las grol te/

sangs rgyas nyid thob par the tshom med do zhes bstan pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung ba dang / gzengs stod pa stabs gcig tu bstan pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhugs pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol te/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyis nas 'chi ba yod ma yin/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal rnam las grol/ /byang chub sems ni nam mi spang / de nyid 'da' bar mi bya bas /rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya ni/ /gang zhig bskyed pa nyid tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /dam pa'i chos la smad mi bya/ /nam yang spong bar mi bya ste/ /mi shes pa 'am gti mug gis/ /rnam par bstan par bya ma yin/ /rdo rje dang ni dril bu dang / /phyag rgya nam yang smad mi bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rang gi bdag nyid yongs spangs te/ /dka' thub kyis kyang gdung mi bya/ /ji lta bde bas bde bzung nas/ /'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de ring bdud rnams 'pham byas nas/ /grong khyer dam par rab tu zhugs/ /deng dus khyed kyis sangs rgyas nyid/ /'thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /zhes brjod nas/ khyed kyi phyi rdul tshon gyis dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag par byas/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so/ /zhes brda sprod dang / bum pa'i dbang ngo / /de nas gsang dbang gi don du/ slob ma rnam snang gi nga rgyal 'dzin pas/ bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur dmigs la/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas/ rdo rje rgyal po theg pa che/ /nam mkha'i spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i mchog /rgyal mchog mchod pa bshad du gsol/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che/

/rdo rje theg pa rab ston pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings dang mtshungs pa'i mchog /rgyal bzhi mchod pa bshad du gsol/ /thar pa'i lam ni rab ston pa/ /theg pa gsum gyi lam la gnas/ /sangs rgyas skal mchog dag pa'i bdag /mi mchog mchod la bshad du gsol/ /byang chub sems ni rgyas pa'i spyan/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ba/ /sku gsung thugs ni shin tu dag /phyag 'tshal rdo rje theg pa la/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ slob ma'i gdong g.yogs te/ /yi ge gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi bsang gtor bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rjer dmigs nas slob mas phul ba'am med na/ bsgoms pa'i lha mo reg rdo rjer bskyed la/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i bde ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ rjes su chags pa'i mes bzhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i rtse mor phab ste/ bde ba chen pos lus kyi lha rnams mnyes par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga na badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod nas/ phaṭ kyi sgras yum gyi mkhar mngon par phab pa/ rgan po dang ming med kyis blang nas/ slob ma'i khar sbyin zhing / 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ slob mas ma hā su kha ho/ zhes brjod de myangs pas/ lus thams cad zag med kyi bde bas gang / lus dkyil gyis lha rnams mnyes/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog 'gags/ gsung rdo rje'i 'od dpag tu med pa'i ngo bor bsgom mo/ /de nas/ gdong g.yogs phye ste/ /khyod kyi bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gis dri ma dag lam rang byin brlabs bsgoms pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa zhes brda sprod/

gsang ba'i dbang ngo / /de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ slob ma 'od dpag tu med pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pas/ bla ma chos kyi skur dmigs la me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /thams cad stong pa'i bdag nyid can/ /mngon par byang chub blta bar 'tshal/ /las dang skye las rnam grol zhing / /snang ba gsum po spangs pa yi/ /mngon par byang chub mthong bar ni/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes che/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rdo rje ye shes bla na med/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /thog mtha' med cing zhi ba dang / /nyon mongs thams cad rnam sbyong zhing / /lus dang ngag dang sems sbyong ba/ /rdo rje chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ snga ma bzhin du slob ma'i gdong g.yogs te bsang gtor byas la/ skad cig gis mi bskyod pa bsgom du bcug mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma reg rdo rjer ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gsum phyag drug mar bskyed nas/ de'i lag nas bzung ste/ khyod kyi dga' ma 'di zungs shig /brten bya sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs/ /'khor lo rim pa'i sbyong ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa spyad par gyis/ /srid pa gsum na rig 'di las/ /gzhan pa'i thabs kyi sangs rgyas min/ /des na 'di dang nam du yang / /khyod kyi 'bral bar ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'di spong bar/ /de la mchog gis dngos grub med/ /ces brjod nas/ slob ma'i lag tu sbyin no/ /rig ma des kyang 'di skad ces/ bshang gci la sogs za ba dang / khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha/ /rtag par bud med mchog gus pas/

/bha ga'i pad+mor 'o byed pa/ /ji ltar spro bar byed dam ci/ /ji ltar dga' ba smros shig bu/ /zhes dris pa'i lan du/ bshang gci bdud rtsi bza' bya ba/ /bud med rtag gus cis mi bgyid/ /bha ga'i pad+mor 'o byed pa/ /lha mo bdag ni cis mi spro/ /zhes lan btab pas/ de mnyes te gsang ba'i pad+ma bstan te/ 'di skad du/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /gang zhig cho ga bzhin bsten pa/ /de yi mdun na nga gnas te/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu zhugs/ /bha dza mo k+ṣa hoḥzhes brjod nas/ slob ma'i pang du byon pa dang / 'du shes gsum dang ldan pas snyoms par zhugs pas/ byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas/ mgrin par byon pa na/ sems snang ba dga' ba'i ye shes/ snying khar byon pa na/ snang ba mched pa mchog dga'i ye shes/ lte bar byon pa na/ snang ba nyer thob dga' bral gyi ye shes/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor byon pa na/ thams cad stong pa 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bar byas nas re zhig mnyam par bzhag go /gal te thig le mi thub par 'dzag na/ don grub kyi nga rgyal gyis/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la byang chub kyi sems kyis mchod par bsams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ zhes brjod do/ /de nas rig ma des/ spyi bor lag pa bzhag nas/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags par dang / /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya 'o/ /de ring phan chad bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rmi lam ji bzhin sems can gyi/ /don ni bla na med par byos/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa yi/ /'di ni man ngag las ni shes/ /rig ma 'di ni dor byas nas/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/

/brtul zhugs rnams kyis mchog gis mchog /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bu yis spyod/ /de ltar 'di ni rnal 'byor mchog /rdo rje rnal 'byor rnal 'byor mchog /rim pa ji bzhin yongs shes bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang bsten/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / de'i lan du/ slob mas kyang / bdag la dngos grub mchog bstsal lags/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu'ang stsal/ /sems can kun la ci 'dod par/ /dngos grub bla na med pa bstsal/ /zhes tshig gi gtang rag tu dbul lo/ /de nas khyod kyis/ byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag lam 'od gsal bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku mngon du gyur pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so zhes brda sprad do/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo / /de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ slob ma mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pas/ bla ma sku gsum dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin du dmigs la/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gyis/ /gtso bo bdag la bka' drin skyobs/ /khyod zhabs pad mo spang nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis/ /bdag la nges par dbang bskur cig /ces lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab nas/ snga ma bzhin du slob ma'i gdong g.yogs/ bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyi gnas su bcug la/ de nas/ dbang bzhi pa tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprad par bya ste/ de la 'dir dbang bzhi pa ni/ thams cad stong pa 'od gsal yin la/ de mngon du byed pa yang / sgyu lus bsgom pa sngon du 'gro ba can yin te/ ji skad du/ bdag byin rlabs pa'i rim gyis ni/ /'od gsal ba ni thob par 'gyur/ /de bas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /dang por bdag la byin brlabs bstan/ /zhes gsungs shing /

bdag byin rlabs de'ang / rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i sku/ mtshan dpe sogs rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa/ me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu zhig ste/ de skad du yang / dngos dang dngos med las grol ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris pa/ /me long dri ma med pa la/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar snang dang mtshungs/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan zhing / /sku ni lta bas mi ngoms pa/ /slob ma bzang po de la bstan/ /bdag byin brlabs zhes de bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de bas na dang por slob ma/ sems snang ba gsum gyi nyer len dang / rlung lnga'i lhan cig byed rkyen las grub pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i sku/ rdo rje 'chang chen po snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur bsgom du bcug nas/ slar yang de nyid me long la has btab pa'am/ nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar thams cad stong pa 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim pas/ rtags rnams rim gyis 'byung ste/ dang por sa chu la thim pas smig sgyu lta bu/ de'i 'og tu chu me la thim pas du ba lta bu/ de'i 'og tu me rlung la thim pas me khyer lta bu/ de'i 'og tu rlung rnam shes la thim pas mar me 'bar ba lta bu/ de'i 'og tu rnam shes 'od gsal la thim pa na/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog rim gyis 'gags pas/ sems snang ba gsum gyi ye shes rim gyi mngon du 'gyur te/ thog mar 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rang bzhin sum cu rtsa gsum 'gags pas/ byang chub kyi sems kun tu bzang po dang po snang ba'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa dang zla ba'i 'od zer shar ba lta bu/ de nas zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rang bzhin bzhi bcu 'gags pas/ byang chub kyi sems kun tu bzang po gnyis pa snang ba mched pa'i ye shes sngon du gyur pa na/ nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ba lta bu/ de nas gti mug las gyur pa'i rang bzhin bdun 'gags pas/ byang chub kyi sems kun tu bzang po gsum pa snang ba nyer thob kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa na/

mtshams kyi mun pa lta bus dran rig gi rtog pa ma lus pa 'gags pa ci yang mi gsal ba'i ngo bo can 'byung / de'i 'og tu snang ba nyer thob 'od gsal la thim pa na/ dper na/ tho rangs kyi sprin med pa'i nam mkha' snang mun gyi sgrib byed thams cad bral bas/ nam mkha'i rang mdog ji lta ba mthong ba bzhin du yul yul can sogs spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad nye bar zhi bas/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs don dam pa'i bden pa/ chu la chu bzhag pa dang / mar la mar bzhag gi tshul du so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi mngon du gyur pa ni/ thams cad stong pa 'od gsal zhes kyang bya/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / de bzhin nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / don dam pa'i bden pa zhes kyang bya ste de nyid dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo yin no zhes brda sprad nas/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba zhes sogs brjod nas cung zhig mnyam par 'jog tu gzhug go /'od gsal de 'bab zhig la gnas na/ zhi ba myang 'das kyi mthar ltung bar 'gyur bas chu la nya ldang ba'am/ gnyid log pa myur bar sad pa ltar sngon gyis 'phen pa'i dbang gis/ 'od gsal de nyid las langs te/ sbrul shun pa brjes pa ltar ma dag pa'i lus spangs nas lugs bzlog gi snang ba gsum rlung dang bcas pa las dag pa'i sgyu lus grib ma ltar bcad du med cing gzhig tu med pa/ mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus mngon sum du byas pa ni/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i snying po yin no zhes brda sprad do/ /de nas slob mas kyang de kho na nyid la yid ches shing spro ba bskyed pa'i tshul gyis/ e ma ho sangs rgyas e ma ho chos/ /chos bshad pa ni ngo mtshar che/ /yang dag don ni dag pa'i don/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas gdong g.yogs bsal nas/

khyod kyi don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du tshig dbang rin chen bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum bag chags dang bcas pa'i dri ma dag lam zung 'jug bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sku gsum dbyer med rdo rje 'chang chen po mngon du byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so zhes brda sprad/ dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas gsum pa mjug gi bya ba la gnyis te/ slob ma'i bya ba dang / bla ma'i bya ba'o/ /dang po la yang dam tshig bsdus te khas blang ba dang / yon dbul ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ dngos su ci 'byor ba'i yon phul nas/ yid kyi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad 'bul bar bsams nas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyis/ /khyed kyi slob mar gzung ba dang / /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum du brjod do/ /gnyis pa bla ma'i bya ba la gsum gyis/ dkyil 'khor mchod cing dngos grub blang ba ni/ bla mas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la/ phyi nang gsang ba yid las byung ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod pas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ji ltar 'dod pa rnams la gsol ba gdab bo/ /gnyis pa bzod par gsol zhing lhag chad kha skang ba ni/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ /zhes brjod nas/ lhag chad skang ba'i phyir du zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba'am/ ma grub na yig ge brgya pa mang du bzlas so/ /gsum pa smon lam gdab cing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ de nas las bsags pa 'bras bu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ sems thams cad bde gyur cing / /sems thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa/ /des ni sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces sogs smon lam rgya cher btab nas/

dkyil 'khor la ma bstim pa'i lha tshogs rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la bstim pa rnams ni rab tu gnas pa mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir brtan par bzhugs su gsol lo/ /de nas rang nyid cho ga gsum gyi bsrungs la/ las kyi rjes bsdus nas/ rgyun gyis rnal 'byor la gnas par bya'o/ /'di sbyar dge bas mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/ /smin byed dbang bzhi'i rim pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /grol byed rim gnyis zab mo'i lam bsgoms te/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i rim pa don gsal ba 'di ni/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i dkyil 'khor kyis cho ga gzhir byas nas/ tshig don gyi cha ma bde ba rnams cung zad bcos zhing / bu ston rin po che'i dkyil chog gi legs cha rnams kyang blangs nas/ las dang po pa rnams kyis 'jug bde bar bya ba'i phyir/ dge slong gzhon nu blo gros kyis lha yul gung thang gi dben gnas ri 'dabs su sbyar ba'i yi ge'i mtshams sbyor ne po bas bgyis pa dge'o/ /'dis bstan pa dang sems can mang po la phan thogs par gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 32 red mda' ba/ gsang 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i rim pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
